title: Evaluating authenticity and quality of image captions via sentiment and semantic analyses

bias_targets.methodology: The study calculates sentiment scores for human and model-generated captions using a pre-trained Twitter-RoBERTa-base model and assesses the influence of specific object categories (e.g., animals, food, furniture) on these scores using multiple linear regression.
The paper evaluates how the presence of specific object categories in images systematically influences the sentiment (positive/negative) and semantic variability of the corresponding captions.
